adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` defines computed keys as `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. Since `z.string()` returns an object, `.toString()` yields the literal key `"[object Object]"`, and the second definition overwrites the first. As a result, in sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`) the schema effectively validates only `access_token` and strips other fields (including any expiry fields like `expiry_date`/`expires_in`). Downstream code (e.g., Office365 `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`) will not receive updated expiry values, leaving stale/expired expiry data and potentially forcing refresh on every call.
